claims.value: 34 DIA-PASEF CSF runs from people with systemic lupus erythematosus.
claims.evidence: RAW names provide participant identifiers; the deposited sample workbook provides exact ages for 32 of 34 identifiers.

limitations: Sex and cluster membership are not assigned because the 34 deposited acquisitions do not match the 29-person publication cohort closely enough to broadcast cohort claims.
The preparation used Lys-C followed by Trypsin; the selected builder contract represents the final Trypsin cleavage column and the reconciler therefore reports incomplete dual-enzyme representation.
